cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI in Cheshire video about OpenAI's Decision API, which was just released in public beta after its announcement a week ago at their Dev Day.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹 OpenAI 的 Decision API；它在一週前 DevDay 公布後，剛進入公開測試。

cues.en: So the Decision API is OpenAI's answer to the Dev system that have been very hyped in the last couple of weeks.
cues.zh: Decision API 是 OpenAI 對最近幾週受到關注的決策系統所提出的方案。

cues.en: That is this new way of making easy decisions, probabilities, choices for an AI model.
cues.zh: 這是一種讓 AI 模型輕量處理決策、機率與選擇的新方式。

cues.en: So not the normal agents, not the normal text-based systems, but something where we get back structure every time.
cues.zh: 不是一般代理程式或文字回覆，而是每次都取得結構化結果。

cues.en: It's a little like structured output, just a lightweight version of it.
cues.zh: 有點像結構化輸出的輕量版本。

cues.en: And OpenAI have now released it in public beta with a GA coming in a couple of weeks.
cues.zh: OpenAI 現在已開放公開測試，預計幾週後正式推出。

cues.en: And it's launched together with GPT-6 Luna, which is the model that is available.
cues.zh: 它與 GPT-6 Luna 一起推出，目前可用的就是這個模型。

cues.en: They will probably add more later on.
cues.zh: 之後應該會再加入其他模型。

cues.en: And this is a new way of working with OpenAI to the point where it's not yet available in Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這是新的 OpenAI 操作方式，目前 Azure OpenAI 尚未提供。

cues.en: I think they will not do it during the beta, but once it's out, it will come to the various places that also host the OpenAI models.
cues.zh: 我猜測測試期間不會上 Azure，但正式推出後，其他代管 OpenAI 模型的平台也會陸續支援。

cues.en: But the way it works is like GIF from TypeSaver.
cues.zh: 運作方式類似 TypeSafe 提供的決策系統。

cues.en: If you have seen that video, you will know immediately then that we give a bunch of questions, and we get a bunch of answers back.
cues.zh: 如果看過那支影片，就會知道：我們提供一組問題，再取得一組答案。

cues.en: And those answers often have probabilities in how they are related to the input.
cues.zh: 答案通常包含與輸入內容相關的機率。

cues.en: And OpenAI is exactly the same.
cues.zh: OpenAI 也完全相同。

cues.en: They have slightly different names for things, but beyond that, it's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 只是名稱稍有不同，其他基本上相同。

cues.en: So we can have three types of questions.
cues.zh: 可以提出三種類型的問題。

cues.en: We can have a predicate, meaning a true false statement, or how close it is to true, so a value between zero and one.
cues.zh: 第一種是 Predicate，判斷真假，或回傳接近真的程度，也就是零到一之間的值。

cues.en: We can have a choice where we choose one of several categories.
cues.zh: 第二種是 Choice，從多個分類中選擇一個。

cues.en: And we can have scores, which is a weighted average across multiple different choices you could have.
cues.zh: 第三種是 Score，根據多種選擇的機率，計算加權平均分數。

cues.en: And the way they show it over here is they show how dented is this object, and it can give a probability of that.
cues.zh: 官方這裡示範的是物體凹陷程度，並回傳對應機率。

cues.en: Because OpenAI actually have image capability out of the box, while TypeSaver has just said that will happen soon,
cues.zh: 因為 OpenAI 預設就能處理圖片；TypeSafe 雖然說即將支援，

cues.en: but it's not there yet.
cues.zh: 目前卻還沒有。

cues.en: So immediately, OpenAI has that advantage.
cues.zh: 因此 OpenAI 立刻就有這個優勢。

cues.en: It will also have the advantage of being on Azure.
cues.zh: 未來也有整合 Azure 的優勢。

cues.en: And easier to just get into your portfolio if you already have the OpenAI models in there.
cues.zh: 如果本來就在使用 OpenAI 模型，也更容易納入既有系統。

cues.en: So I will definitely go with the Decisions API, despite it being a slightly big bit.
cues.zh: 所以我會傾向使用 Decisions API，雖然價格稍高。

cues.en: You could argue much more expensive, because if you look at the pricing down here, it's using the Lunar prices with 0.10 per million tokens in,
cues.zh: 甚至可以說貴不少，因為下方價格使用 Luna 的費率，每百萬輸入 Token 是 0.10，

cues.en: which is dirt cheap.
cues.zh: 其實已經非常便宜。

cues.en: But Jeff over here was 0.00 something.
cues.zh: 但另一個系統是 0.00 開頭的價格。

cues.en: But at the same time, they are not charging for output tokens, just like Jeff is as well.
cues.zh: 同時，它和另一個系統一樣，不收取輸出 Token 費用。

cues.en: So it will be dirt cheap to use this.
cues.zh: 所以整體使用成本還是很低。

cues.en: So let's have a look on how we implement it, actually.
cues.zh: 接著看看如何實作。

cues.en: So I have implemented it in my agent framework toolkits, which is a bunch of NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 我已把它整合進 Agent Framework Toolkit，也就是一組 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And I've implemented it in the OpenAI package so far, with later on when it makes sense in some of the other ones.
cues.zh: 目前放在 OpenAI 套件中；之後其他供應商適合支援時再加入。

cues.en: Now, I'm going to show you how to implement it in my agent framework toolkits.
cues.zh: 接下來示範如何透過 Agent Framework Toolkit 使用。

cues.en: So I'm going to show you how to implement it in my agent framework toolkits.
cues.zh: 也就是在 Toolkit 裡使用這項功能。

cues.en: We won't go into too much details on how I implemented it, because it's a fairly simple request-response.
cues.zh: 不會深入內部實作，因為只是簡單的請求與回應。

cues.en: So it's not even using the OpenAI client that we normally use here.
cues.zh: 甚至沒有使用平常的 OpenAIClient。

cues.en: It's just using request-response using an HTTP.
cues.zh: 只是直接透過 HTTP 發送請求並接收回覆。

cues.en: Also, what you will see is that my way of doing this is a very opinionated way, just as my Jeff does.
cues.zh: 另外，我的封裝採用明確的使用方式，和之前的決策套件一樣。

cues.en: While being open to extend it further on to more dynamic scenarios, if need be.
cues.zh: 不過仍保留日後擴充更動態情境的空間。

cues.en: But I wanted to feel really, really good for .NET, so I've made it very opinionated, which we will see in one second.
cues.zh: 我希望它很符合 .NET 開發體驗，因此設計得比較強型別，稍後就會看到。

cues.en: Because the way we can look at it is if I jump into my samples repo, links in the description of that,
cues.zh: 進入影片說明連結中的範例儲存庫，

cues.en: it's a little bit different from what I'm used to.
cues.zh: 這次和之前慣用的方式稍有不同。

cues.en: So I'm going to jump into the description of that.
cues.zh: 直接看看這個範例。

cues.en: It's a lot like structured output.
cues.zh: 它很像結構化輸出。

cues.en: And one of my structured output videos I made many months ago was that I had an intent agent that helped choose
cues.zh: 幾個月前介紹結構化輸出時，我做過意圖代理程式，幫忙判斷，

cues.en: if something was a movie question or a music question.
cues.zh: 問題是與電影還是音樂有關。

cues.en: So if we run that back, just to see how we did it that way, let's get some information about Elvis.
cues.zh: 先重新執行舊範例，看看當時怎麼做，例如詢問 Elvis 的資訊。

cues.en: It would use an agent and then would use structured output of intent result, giving us back an object.
cues.zh: 它使用代理程式，透過 IntentResult 的結構化輸出，回傳物件。

cues.en: That would, once we have done here, would tell us if it was a music question, a movie question, or another question.
cues.zh: 執行後，就會告訴我們這是音樂、電影，還是其他問題。

cues.en: In this case, it was apparently unclear to it, probably because Elvis can both be in movies and music.
cues.zh: 這次它好像有點不確定，可能因為 Elvis 同時涉及電影與音樂。

cues.en: So let's do something completely obvious.
cues.zh: 換個非常明確的例子。

cues.en: Let's say, The Godfather.
cues.zh: 例如《教父》。

cues.en: Hopefully, that should be known as a movie question, which it is.
cues.zh: 希望它知道這是電影問題，結果確實如此。

cues.en: And then we have a switch that turns user-specific agent.
cues.zh: 再透過 switch，交給對應的專門代理程式。

cues.en: So this could also be a hard question or an easy question.
cues.zh: 也可以用來判斷問題是難還是簡單，

cues.en: Is it support-related?
cues.zh: 是否與客服有關，

cues.en: Is it billing-related? And so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 是否與帳務有關，等等。

cues.en: But this is the old way of doing things.
cues.zh: 不過這是原本的做法。

cues.en: The drawback is that while structured output are cool, it can be slow at times.
cues.zh: 缺點是結構化輸出雖然很好用，有時速度比較慢。

cues.en: So let's jump into the decision API.
cues.zh: 接著看看 Decision API。

cues.en: I'm just using my NuGet package, agent-framework-toolkit.openai, to do this.
cues.zh: 只需要使用我的 AgentFrameworkToolkit.OpenAI NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And we will see a few different samples on what it can do.
cues.zh: 會看幾個不同範例。

cues.en: So in our case here, let's go in again and ask for The Godfather. The Godfather.
cues.zh: 這裡再輸入一次《教父》。

cues.en: And we will see that I knew of a decision factory, which is just like an agent factory.
cues.zh: 先建立 DecisionFactory，就像建立 AgentFactory 一樣。

cues.en: And I've even made it so you can actually go in and say, on your agent, you can say agent.decisions, and then get the factory.
cues.zh: 我也提供了 agent.Decisions，能直接從既有代理程式取得 Factory。

cues.en: So if you already have an agent, it's easy to get hold of the decision factory as well.
cues.zh: 所以如果已經有代理程式，就很容易取得決策功能。

cues.en: But then we get a decision factory, and we can then ask various different questions.
cues.zh: 有了 DecisionFactory，就能提出各種問題。

cues.en: In this case, we're doing a choice async, where we go in and choose the intent.
cues.zh: 這裡呼叫 ChoiceAsync，要求選出 Intent。

cues.en: And the intent is just the enum.
cues.zh: Intent 只是一個 enum。

cues.en: So we simply say, choose for me the intent based on the question.
cues.zh: 也就是說，請根據問題替我選擇意圖。

cues.en: Is this question about music, movies, or something else?
cues.zh: 這個問題是與音樂、電影，還是其他事情有關？

cues.en: And the input is The Godfather.
cues.zh: 輸入是《教父》。

cues.en: And when you press here, it will come back.
cues.zh: 執行後就會取得結果。

cues.en: And GIF seemed to be a little bit faster, but once we are running here,
cues.zh: 另一個決策系統似乎更快一些，不過目前這裡，

cues.en: I have seen it being down to 200 milliseconds like this.
cues.zh: 我也看過只有兩百毫秒的結果。

cues.en: So it is definitely faster than structured output, but it's not like instantly faster like GIF is at times.
cues.zh: 確實比結構化輸出快，但不像另一個系統有時那麼接近即時。

cues.en: It might just be because a lot of people are hitting it right now.
cues.zh: 也可能只是目前很多人同時使用。

cues.en: And it's only in the public beta.
cues.zh: 而且它還在公開測試。

cues.en: But essentially, it's just making our choice.
cues.zh: 基本上就是替我們做出選擇。

cues.en: And in our case, it was a movie question.
cues.zh: 這裡判斷是電影問題。

cues.en: And then we can do exactly the same here as a choice for us.
cues.zh: 接著就能像原本一樣，把這個選擇，

cues.en: And use a normal agent to do the work.
cues.zh: 交給一般代理程式執行。

cues.en: So we are essentially just making it an dispatcher right now.
cues.zh: 所以目前只是把它當成分派器。

cues.en: We can also do more advanced things than just a choice.
cues.zh: 不過也能做比單純選擇更進階的事情。

cues.en: So let's run it again here and set a breakpoint.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，設個中斷點。

cues.en: Because we can also ask, let's just again ask about The Godfather
cues.zh: 一樣先用《教父》作為輸入，

cues.en: and do a decision factory.
cues.zh: 建立 DecisionFactory。

cues.en: And here we can ask a request about, is this question about a movie?
cues.zh: 這次提出的請求是：「這個問題與電影有關嗎？」

cues.en: Our input is The Godfather and our threshold is 0.7.
cues.zh: 輸入是《教父》，門檻值設成 0.7。

cues.en: So are we more than 70% sure that this is about a movie?
cues.zh: 也就是確定程度是否高於百分之七十？

cues.en: And then we can ask that question using an is true async and just get a Boolean back, in our case, true,
cues.zh: 透過 IsTrueAsync，直接取得 Boolean；這裡是 true，

cues.en: because we are more than 70% sure that this is about a movie.
cues.zh: 因為它有超過百分之七十的把握，認為問題與電影有關。

cues.en: If you don't give a threshold, it will be 0.5.
cues.zh: 如果不提供門檻，預設是 0.5。

cues.en: But else, you can choose if you want to be extra short before it turns into a Boolean.
cues.zh: 也可以在轉成 Boolean 之前，要求更高的確定程度。

cues.en: If you don't want it to be a Boolean, but just a number that you can then evaluate on, you can instead say decision factory.probability with the same request.
cues.zh: 如果不想直接取得 Boolean，而是要自行評估數值，可以對相同請求呼叫 Probability。

cues.en: And then you get a probability object back.
cues.zh: 就會回傳機率物件。

cues.en: And we can see in this case, it is 0.5.
cues.zh: 這裡可以查看機率數值，

cues.en: In this case, it is 96% sure that this is actually a movie.
cues.zh: 這次它有百分之九十六的把握，認為與電影有關。

cues.en: So good for us, because we had our question, if it was about a movie or not.
cues.zh: 這很符合我們判斷是否電影問題的需求。

cues.en: And in the same manner, we can, of course, then ask about something else.
cues.zh: 同樣也可以詢問其他內容。

cues.en: Let's ask about ACDC.
cues.zh: 例如 AC/DC。

cues.en: And you can see how fast it responses and comes back.
cues.zh: 可以看到它回覆得很快。

cues.en: That is probability 0. It's not a movie.
cues.zh: 機率是零，不是電影。

cues.en: While if we go for Elvis,
cues.zh: 如果換成 Elvis，

cues.en: just remove these breakpoints so we can see.
cues.zh: 先把中斷點移除，方便觀察。

cues.en: We can see that the movie question probability went up because Elvis actually made a bunch of movies as well.
cues.zh: 電影機率就提高了，因為 Elvis 確實也演過很多電影。

cues.en: So you decide if you want to be a hard yes, no, true, false, using is true, or if you want it to be a probability
cues.zh: 因此你可以決定，要用 IsTrue 取得明確的是非判斷，還是取得，

cues.en: you get back between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 零到一之間的機率。

cues.en: So this is the opinionated part that if you just want, am I going into this if statement or this if statement?
cues.zh: 這就是強型別封裝的部分：如果只是要判斷應該進入哪一個 if，

cues.en: It's almost as close as you don't feel like you're waiting for an agent as much as you do with the others.
cues.zh: 它的速度讓你比較不會感覺自己在等待一個代理程式。

cues.en: So that is very cool in what we can do there, but we can do even more.
cues.zh: 這已經很實用，但還能做更多。

cues.en: So we can also do what is called a score.
cues.zh: 也可以取得 Score。

cues.en: So let's set a breakpoint for that and see that in action.
cues.zh: 設個中斷點，實際看看。

cues.en: So let's just again take The Godfather. And see.
cues.zh: 再用《教父》當例子。

cues.en: Here we're going to do a score of if it's a movie, how relevant it is to a movie.
cues.zh: 這次要評估與電影的相關程度。

cues.en: It's about music, not movies.
cues.zh: 第一個選項是關於音樂，不是電影。

cues.en: It's about music and movies, so it could be both.
cues.zh: 第二個是同時關於音樂與電影。

cues.en: And it's about movies, not music.
cues.zh: 第三個是關於電影，不是音樂。

cues.en: So we are simply giving an enum grading scale from low to medium to high or to swing in the direction of music,
cues.zh: 相當於用 enum 定義一個從低、中、高，或偏向音樂，

cues.en: swing in the direction of movies.
cues.zh: 到偏向電影的評分量尺。

cues.en: And when we do that, we get a score from a movie relevance.
cues.zh: 接著取得 MovieRelevance 的分數。

cues.en: And that score will come back to us and we will be able to see that confidence-wise in answering the question was 93%.
cues.zh: 回傳後，可以看到這次回答的信心程度是百分之九十三。

cues.en: It had various probabilities.
cues.zh: 另外有各項選擇的機率。

cues.en: It feels like it's 0.02 that it's about music.
cues.zh: 它認為關於音樂的機率是 0.02，

cues.en: It's 0.01, meaning 1% it's both, and it's 97% sure it's about movies.
cues.zh: 兩者都有是 0.01，也就是百分之一；關於電影則是百分之九十七。

cues.en: And it will get back our descriptions.
cues.zh: 也會回傳我們提供的描述。

cues.en: And these descriptions just come from descriptions you add onto enums.
cues.zh: 這些描述來自 enum 上加的 Description。

cues.en: They are not mandatory, but you can add them onto it in order to get that.
cues.zh: 不是必填，但需要時可以加入。

cues.en: If we then look at the relevance, we just saw the confidence, and then it will just loop to our system.
cues.zh: 剛才看的是信心程度，接著查看實際相關性分數。

cues.en: So it would come back and say, yeah, this is 1.95, meaning this is a gradient scale.
cues.zh: 這裡回傳 1.95，也就是連續的評分數值。

cues.en: So the closer to two it is, it's about movies.
cues.zh: 越接近二，就越偏向電影。

cues.en: The closer to zero it is, it's about music.
cues.zh: 越接近零，就越偏向音樂。

cues.en: And it just gives us back our samples here.
cues.zh: 這裡也列出各項結果。

cues.en: So if we instead sell Elvis and let it run,
cues.zh: 如果改成 Elvis 再執行，

cues.en: it is less confident that it has a clear decision.
cues.zh: 它就不那麼確定能做出明確分類。

cues.en: It feels like it's mostly music.
cues.zh: 主要仍偏向音樂，

cues.en: It could be movies, and the boat actually went up because he was both in movies and did music.
cues.zh: 也有電影機率，而且「兩者都有」的機率提高，因為他既演電影也做音樂。

cues.en: But it's still leaning toward music, which makes total sense in the table set.
cues.zh: 整體仍偏音樂，這很合理。

cues.en: Right now, I'm just writing one word here.
cues.zh: 目前只是輸入一個詞。

cues.en: This can be long conversations or reference to a review or a support ticket or anything.
cues.zh: 實際也可以輸入長對話、評論、客服單等內容。

cues.en: I'm just testing the raw values here.
cues.zh: 這裡只是測試簡單的輸入值。

cues.en: So that's the score part.
cues.zh: 以上是 Score。

cues.en: And so far, we've just seen it use one simple question at the time, but it is also possible to answer multiple questions at the time in one call.
cues.zh: 目前每次只提出一個問題，其實也能一次呼叫回答多個問題。

cues.en: So for that, we have something called Create Decision.
cues.zh: 這時使用 CreateDecision。

cues.en: And if we go in, and this is not about movies and music, but this is more about some service.
cues.zh: 這個例子不再是電影與音樂，而是客服服務。

cues.en: So if I say the device is broken,
cues.zh: 例如輸入：「裝置壞掉了」。

cues.en: so that's our input.
cues.zh: 這就是輸入內容。

cues.en: It could be a review, it could be a support question and so on.
cues.zh: 它可以來自評論，也可以是客服問題。

cues.en: We then again go in and make a decision factory.
cues.zh: 同樣先建立 DecisionFactory。

cues.en: And then we say we want to have an OpenAI decision response of type CustomerSupportDecision.
cues.zh: 再要求回傳 CustomerSupportDecision 型別的 OpenAI 決策結果。

cues.en: And CustomerSupportDecision is our object.
cues.zh: CustomerSupportDecision 是我們定義的物件。

cues.en: In that, in here, you add the various things you want to have questions about, and the questions are set as attributes on those.
cues.zh: 在物件中加入各種想問的項目，再用屬性標記指定問題。

cues.en: So you can see that when we make a choice about what support department this should go to, technical support, billing, or customer service,
cues.zh: 例如判斷應交給哪個部門：技術支援、帳務或客戶服務，

cues.en: we can get the selected department back as a strongly typed object,
cues.zh: 可以直接取得選中的部門列舉值，

cues.en: or we can get it back as a choice of support department.
cues.zh: 也可以取得 DecisionChoice<SupportDepartment>。

cues.en: Both systems work.
cues.zh: 兩種方式都可以。

cues.en: You can see it's the same question we give it.
cues.zh: 可以看到，兩者提出的是相同問題。

cues.en: But here we will get the more details about what probability and confidence level it had to do that.
cues.zh: 但這個版本會包含更完整的機率與信心程度。

cues.en: In the same manner, we can do a probability question and either get it back as a Boolean, a double, a decimal, or an object for probability.
cues.zh: 同樣地，機率問題可以回傳 Boolean、double、decimal，或完整機率物件。

cues.en: We can do the scores, and we can go get those scores back just as the number, the raw value, how close it is to the different values,
cues.zh: Score 也能只回傳數字，也就是與各選項的加權關係，

cues.en: so decimal or as the score object back.
cues.zh: 例如 decimal，或回傳完整的 Score 物件。

cues.en: So this way, you're building your objects, and then you're just calling the system.
cues.zh: 因此先定義自己的物件，再呼叫系統即可。

cues.en: And if I call it using the create decision async here of that type, I will get an object back.
cues.zh: 使用泛型 CreateDecisionAsync，就能取得對應物件。

cues.en: And that object has more information than we have just seen.
cues.zh: 外層回覆也包含更多資訊。

cues.en: It has input tokens and output tokens in the system.
cues.zh: 例如輸入與輸出 Token 用量。

cues.en: And again, the output token count is zero because we don't pay for it, but they put it into the API to be sure that if they change that back at some point.
cues.zh: 輸出 Token 是零，因為目前不收費；API 仍保留這個欄位，方便未來調整。

cues.en: And then we get our result objects.
cues.zh: 接著是 Result 物件。

cues.en: And our result object is then the various different properties we have of this object.
cues.zh: 它包含我們自己定義的各個屬性。

cues.en: This is done using reflection.
cues.zh: 這是透過反射實作。

cues.en: So our department came back as a choice, where we could see that it was technical support.
cues.zh: Department 的詳細結果是 Choice，裡面顯示選了技術支援。

cues.en: But if we look at the result directly, we could also see that we got that in the selected department directly here.
cues.zh: 直接查看 Result，也能在 SelectedDepartment 取得同樣的分類。

cues.en: So if you're just interested in, yeah, it's technical support, you just make it as a property of the enum.
cues.zh: 所以如果只在乎是不是技術支援，就把屬性定義成 enum。

cues.en: And if you want it more detailed with confidence levels and probabilities of each one of them, seeing here that it was 99% was technical support, but it could have been customer service.
cues.zh: 如果需要各項機率與信心程度，也能取得；例如這裡百分之九十九是技術支援，但仍有一點可能是客戶服務。

cues.en: That's your choice if you want to use those or just have the simple objects back or more complex.
cues.zh: 要用簡單值還是完整物件，完全由你選擇。

cues.en: So this is a little more difficult to discover that you need to build your own objects.
cues.zh: 這種做法比較不容易一眼發現，因為要自行建立結果物件。

cues.en: But in many cases, you'll probably just use the simple questions.
cues.zh: 但很多情況應該只需要簡單問題。

cues.en: But if you have multiple questions, you can group them up into a complex object like this.
cues.zh: 如果有多個問題，再把它們集合成這種複合物件。

cues.en: And then we'll just write back to us what was all the details about, the department details, the technical support details, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 接著就能輸出部門、技術支援等各種詳細資訊。

cues.en: And the severity down here, it could see that it feels like it was a blocking issue, it was a degrading issue, so the various different scores in multiple.
cues.zh: 下方的嚴重程度，也可以評估是完全阻礙使用，還是只是功能退化，透過多個分數表示。

cues.en: That is the different options.
cues.zh: 這就是各種選項。

cues.en: Again, there's only three different things we can do, and we can then multiply them into more, but we can also do images. So for images,
cues.zh: 再強調，基本上只有三種決策，能組合成多個問題；另外也支援圖片。

cues.en: I just found a small image of some various different animals.
cues.zh: 這裡我找了一張有各種動物的圖片。

cues.en: And then I wanted to ask if that animal was in the picture or not.
cues.zh: 想詢問某隻動物是否出現在圖片裡。

cues.en: But I also wanted to be able to say if it was at the top of the image or at the bottom of the image.
cues.zh: 同時也想判斷它位於圖片上方還是下方。

cues.en: And for that reason, let's have a look here.
cues.zh: 因此看看這段程式。

cues.en: And let's run it.
cues.zh: 先執行。

cues.en: So let me ask, is there a tiger in the image?
cues.zh: 我們問：「圖片裡有老虎嗎？」

cues.en: Because now we're going to chain these decision models.
cues.zh: 這裡會串接幾個決策模型。

cues.en: In this case, very simple, but we could have again the multiple objects.
cues.zh: 這次很簡單，但同樣也可以使用複合物件。

cues.en: But we're just going to make the image into data content, just like we have in the agent framework.
cues.zh: 先把圖片轉成 DataContent，就像 Agent Framework 裡的做法。

cues.en: And then we're going to say, is it true that we are asking for a location about this?
cues.zh: 再判斷，使用者是否在詢問位置。

cues.en: And in my case, I was just asking if there's an image, not a location of it.
cues.zh: 我這次只問有沒有老虎，沒有問位置。

cues.en: So this should hopefully come back as false.
cues.zh: 所以這裡應該回傳 false。

cues.en: And when we didn't ask that question, we are using another decision to figure out if it's true, if the object is in the image or not.
cues.zh: 既然不是位置問題，就使用另一個決策，判斷圖片中是否有指定物件。

cues.en: So based on the image, is the answer to the users, there's no question yes, or is it a statement true?
cues.zh: 根據圖片，使用者這個是非問題的答案是否為真？

cues.en: In our case, it's true.
cues.zh: 這裡是 true。

cues.en: Let me remove these breakpoints so we can see.
cues.zh: 把中斷點移除，方便看。

cues.en: So is there a tiger in the image? Yes.
cues.zh: 圖片裡有老虎嗎？有。

cues.en: Is there a goose in the image, which there's not?
cues.zh: 有鵝嗎？圖片裡沒有。

cues.en: Then we'll know that the answer is false, and you can again see how quickly it answers compared to what we normally sit and wait for.
cues.zh: 所以答案是 false，而且和一般代理程式相比，回覆速度很快。

cues.en: Then we can ask, where is the tiger in the image?
cues.zh: 接著可以問：「老虎在圖片的哪裡？」

cues.en: And we'll come and say it's at the bottom.
cues.zh: 它回答在下方。

cues.en: Where is the rabbit?
cues.zh: 「兔子在哪裡？」

cues.en: It's at the top.
cues.zh: 在上方。

cues.en: And we can say, where is the goose in the image?
cues.zh: 「鵝在圖片的哪裡？」

cues.en: And we'll know it's not an image.
cues.zh: 它就知道圖片中沒有鵝。

cues.en: So in that regard, you can control everything, and you can change these, you can add them to multiple, but the true value of this is how cheap it is and how fast it is.
cues.zh: 因此可以控制、串接或一次執行多個決策；真正的價值是便宜，而且快速。

cues.en: So I will definitely, once this is an Azure, begin to get rid of some of, if not all of my various strategies.
cues.zh: 等 Azure 支援後，我一定會開始把一部分，甚至全部這類，

cues.en: Structured output agents that sits and sends code in different directions and turn it into this, because it's just faster.
cues.zh: 用來分派工作的結構化輸出代理程式，改成這種方式，因為速度更快。

cues.en: It's just built for that specific purpose,
cues.zh: 它就是為這種特定用途設計的，

cues.en: finding positions based on just an enum and so on.
cues.zh: 例如根據 enum 找出分類或位置。

cues.en: So the drawback of the way I have built it is that the choices need to be enums, for example.
cues.zh: 我這個封裝的缺點，是 Choice 目前必須使用 enum。

cues.en: It cannot just be random lists of strings, which the API understands.
cues.zh: 不能直接提供任意字串清單，雖然底層 API 支援。

cues.en: But I have chosen this approach to be very, very structured and fit C Sharp well.
cues.zh: 我選擇這樣設計，是希望結構清楚，也符合 C# 的使用習慣。

cues.en: But if you feel like we need a choose async that just can take on string, I can definitely add that to the system.
cues.zh: 如果需要能接受字串的 ChoiceAsync，也可以再加入。

cues.en: But right now, you can simply go to NuGet.
cues.zh: 目前可以直接到 NuGet，

cues.en: You can search for agents, framework, toolkit.
cues.zh: 搜尋 Agent Framework Toolkit，

cues.en: And you can grab the OpenAI version of this that have this feature in.
cues.zh: 取得包含這個功能的 OpenAI 版本。

cues.en: And once the OpenAI client will go in and support this, I will, of course, behind the scenes change agent, framework, toolkit to use that behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 等 OpenAIClient 正式支援後，我也會把 Toolkit 內部改成使用官方用戶端。

cues.en: But beyond that, this should already be up and running.
cues.zh: 不過目前這個功能應該已經能使用。

cues.en: So once, in my case, it's on Azure, I will begin to use this.
cues.zh: 對我而言，等 Azure 支援後就會開始導入。

cues.en: But else it's a cool demo, or if you're already using OpenAI as your primary model provider.
cues.zh: 現在則可以用來展示，或供主要使用 OpenAI 的開發者使用。

cues.en: This is, yeah, a little more expensive.
cues.zh: 價格雖然比另一個專門系統略高，

cues.en: But it feels like it's a nice fit into the package deal that OpenAI with agents, decisions, now embeddings, batches,
cues.zh: 但能和 OpenAI 的代理程式、決策、嵌入向量與批次等功能整合，

cues.en: like no other can really provide at the moment.
cues.zh: 是目前其他平台不容易一次提供的組合。

cues.en: So that is how you use Decision API.
cues.zh: 以上就是 Decision API 的使用方式。

cues.en: Really, really nice to get some faster speed.
cues.zh: 能取得更快的速度，非常實用。

cues.en: It's really only the speed and the cost that is the difference because else we could have done exactly the same as we do here with structured output.
cues.zh: 真正差異只有速度與成本；功能本身原本也能透過結構化輸出完成。

cues.en: But if we can get it faster and cheaper, let's get that.
cues.zh: 但既然可以更快、更便宜，當然值得使用。

cues.en: So with that, thank you for watching and see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝收看，我們下支影片見。
